rawOutput.rationale: Build a compact big-picture cause map first, then use short retrieval checks to separate the alliance structure, the July Crisis sequence, and the 1914 to 1918 timeline.

essentialIdeas: Prewar European alliances and tensions formed two armed blocs with rival military commitments, imperial competition, and nationalism.
The Sarajevo assassination triggered the July Crisis, and mobilization and alliance commitments widened it into declarations of war.
World War I runs from 1914 through 1918, with outbreak, U.S. entry, and the armistice in that order.

activities.title: World War I cause map
activities.body: Read the short model and then move on.

essentialIdeas: Prewar European alliances and tensions formed two armed blocs with rival military commitments, imperial competition, and nationalism.

activities.label: Explain the outbreak sequence
activities.title: Sarajevo to war
activities.body: In your own words, explain how one event spread into a wider war.
activities.concept: Sequence from the Sarajevo assassination to declarations of war
activities.correctAnswer: The Sarajevo assassination set off the July Crisis, and alliance commitments plus mobilization turned that crisis into declarations of war.
activities.feedback: A complete answer names the assassination, the July Crisis, and the widening effect of mobilization and alliances.

activities.label: Repair the timeline
activities.title: Fix the outbreak chain
activities.body: Use the hint to correct your timeline in one sentence.
activities.misconceptionSummary: Thinking the Sarajevo assassination caused instant war without the July Crisis and mobilization steps.
activities.concept: Sequence from the Sarajevo assassination to declarations of war
activities.correctAnswer: The assassination did not cause instant war; it led into the July Crisis, and mobilization and alliance commitments then widened the conflict into declarations of war.
activities.feedback: The key repair is the middle step: the July Crisis and mobilization sit between the assassination and the war declarations.

activities.label: Reexplain the cause map
activities.title: Timeline and turning points
activities.body: Explain the war sequence again, this time with the dates in order.
activities.correctAnswer: World War I began in 1914, the United States entered later in the war, and the armistice ended fighting in 1918.
activities.feedback: A complete answer keeps the timeline in order and ends with the armistice in 1918.

activities.label: Check the full map
activities.title: World War I start and end
activities.feedback: World War I starts in 1914, the United States enters later, and the fighting ends with the 1918 armistice.

methodBriefing.name: Feynman Technique
methodBriefing.what: Explain an idea in plain language, compare it with an accurate source, repair the gaps, and explain it again.
methodBriefing.why: Connecting steps, causes, and prior knowledge can expose shallow understanding and build a more useful mental model.
how: Study one concise explanation or example.
Close it and explain the idea in your own words.
Name the cause, relationship, or reason behind each important step.
Compare with the source, repair the explanation, then teach it back again without copying.

activities.label: Explain
activities.title: War years chronology
activities.body: What is the basic chronology from 1914 to 1918?

activities.correctAnswer: It begins with World War I's outbreak in 1914 and ends with the armistice in 1918.
activities.feedback: The span is defined by the war's start and end, not by intermediate events.
